transcript: hello from London it is the great theatre adventure Day 25 just landed this morning and did a two show day ending with the Ministry of Lesbian Affairs which was an incredible play here at the Kiln Theater uh by the way if you follow two strangers Carry a cake across New York this is the birthplace of that musical and started my day off after landing here by catching the matinee of Benjamin Button which remains one of my favorite shows of 2025 if you come to London and see like a single show make it that one if you see two this is a great two show day absolutely fantastic also one of my favorite things about seeing theater in London is that even though you do have to buy programs at theaters when you go see a play they publish their plays like right away so you can usually buy the play script at the theater which is a great alternative to buying a program and they're super cheap like this is £8 which in the US this would be like $20 you still get the bio of everybody cast as well as the creative team
